name: Varis Thornwood

inventory.notes: Dyed in forest greens, patched at both elbows
Yew, strung with owlbear sinew; carved with his warden's mark
Left by his mentor at the Weeping Oak
Bone flute; he plays the warden's call, badly

inventory.item: Owlbear claw on a leather cord

appearance: Tall and narrow even for a wood elf, copper skin weathered by a century outdoors. Moss-green eyes, black hair cropped short with a hunter's knife, a white scar through his left eyebrow.
backstory:
Varis was a warden of the Hollow Wood for ninety years — one of the elves who walk its edge and turn travellers back before the deep woods swallow them. He knew every trail, every spring, every den, and he was proud that no traveller under his watch had ever been lost.

Then a merchant caravan he had turned away took the old road around the forest instead and was never seen again. Its tracks ended at a ruined watchtower on the Moors, where something had dragged the wagons underground. The warden-council called it the humans' own folly. Varis did not.

He left the forest to follow those tracks, and has learned more about cities, coin and people in two years than in the hundred before. He still counts his arrows every evening, still sleeps facing the door, and still asks every innkeeper about a missing caravan with a green-and-gold banner.
notes: Champion: criticals on 19–20. Fighting style Defense, feat Alert. Prefers the longbow; draws both shortswords when cornered.
